moment: The stray looks from the broken sky to you. “If that thing gets out,” he says, “it will remember being me.” The kit reaches one paw toward the rim. “And if you close it,” the kit says, “he never gets to remember being whole.”
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, strong black ink, monochrome, no colour. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
